_meta.description: Tenders and contract packages for Lines 4 and 4A. Values in crore INR. 'tender_status' is floated, bids_opened, awarded, cancelled or unknown. Only packages whose source was read are listed. Tender search of 2026-10-31: MMRDA's tender archive has no Line 4 notice and its active list on mahatenders has none, so every row is from trade press (graded reported); packages seen only in aggregator listings wait under contractors.json excluded_claims.

tenders.scope: Viaduct and 6 stations, Bhakti Park (Wadala) to Amar Mahal Junction
tenders.notes: Value is the lowest bid. Two of its stations, Suman Nagar and Amar Mahal Junction, were later dropped.

tenders.scope: Viaduct and 7 stations, Garodia Nagar to Surya Nagar
tenders.notes: Value is the lowest bid.

tenders.scope: Viaduct and stations, Gandhi Nagar to Sonapur
tenders.notes: Value is the lowest bid.

tenders.scope: Viaduct and 7 stations, Mulund Fire Station to Majiwada
tenders.notes: Value is the lowest bid.

tenders.scope: Viaduct and 6 stations, Kapurbawdi to Kasarvadavali
tenders.notes: Value is the lowest bid. Indian Infrastructure (May 2018) gives Rs 1,584 crore for the three Reliance-Astaldi packages, which matches 540 + 513 + 531.

tenders.scope: Line 4A: viaduct and 2 stations, Kasarvadavali to Gaimukh
Mogharpada depot for Lines 4, 4A, 10 and 11 on 41 ha, with a double-decker stabling shed, first tender
tenders.notes: Ref MMRDA/4/MMRP/CA-L4C01. Cancelled in May 2021 after 14 corrigenda; no reason given.

tenders.scope: Mogharpada depot: stabling yard, operation control centre, workshops, staff quarters, approach bridge, ETP and STP
tenders.notes: Value is the lowest bid, 27% over the estimate; NCC bid Rs 944.25 crore. The letter of award followed on 26 Sep 2023; a negotiated value was not found. Second tender, after L4-C01.

tenders.scope: 9,800 tonnes of head-hardened rails (60E1, 1080 grade), first tender
tenders.notes: Cancelled, per The Metro Rail Guy's Green Line page; the rails were tendered again as CA-150.

tenders.scope: 9,800 tonnes of head-hardened rails, second tender
tenders.notes: Jindal Steel & Power was the only compliant bidder (Mitsui disqualified); its bid of Rs 110.32 crore was rejected as too high.

tenders.scope: 9,800 tonnes of head-hardened rails, third tender
tenders.notes: Jindal Steel & Power was again the only bidder; cancelled in February 2024. Line 5's CA-203 was cancelled with it.

tenders.scope: Ballastless track, Mulund Fire Station (ch. 18,930) to Gaimukh (ch. 34,702), 15.77 km, with Gaimukh's siding tracks
tenders.notes: Five bidders; next were Texmaco (Rs 124.40 crore) and Paras Railtech (Rs 129.90 crore). Track laying began at Majiwada in September 2024.

tenders.scope: Ballastless track, Bhakti Park to Mulund Fire Station, about 19.5 km, with sidings at Bhakti Park and a pocket track between Sonapur and Mulund Fire Station
tenders.notes: Bids opened 4 Oct 2024: L&T Rs 188.5 crore, Rahee Infratech Rs 195.4 crore, IRCON Rs 201.7 crore. The Metro Rail Guy dates the award to June 2025 at Rs 188.59 crore; Metro Rail News gives the letter of acceptance as 21 Aug 2025.

tenders.scope: 234 standard gauge cars for Lines 4 and 4A
tenders.notes: Won by Bombardier in January 2021; Alstom, which bought Bombardier, ended it in March 2022.

tenders.scope: CBTC signalling, train control and platform screen doors, main line and depot
tenders.notes: Bids opened April 2021: Alstom Rs 443 crore, Hitachi Rail STS Rs 568 crore, Siemens Rs 599 crore. Cancelled, per The Metro Rail Guy's Green Line page; the scope went into CA-234.

tenders.scope: Telecommunication system, main line and depot
tenders.notes: Cancelled, per The Metro Rail Guy's Green Line page; the scope went into CA-234.

tenders.scope: Integrated systems: 39 six-car trains, CBTC signalling and train control, telecom, platform screen doors and Mogharpada depot machinery, with 15 years of maintenance after 2 years of defect liability
tenders.notes: Value is L&T's bid; NCC (with BEML) bid Rs 5,115 crore. Financial bids opened 14 Feb 2025; letter of acceptance after the financial evaluation of 19 Sep 2025. The Metro Rail Guy gives the estimate as Rs 4,297.49 crore. KfW's loan pays for the design and build part (168 weeks); MMRDA pays for the maintenance.

tenders.scope: Power supply and traction, E&M, lifts and escalators for 34 stations, with 15 years of maintenance after 2 years of defect liability (Package 2)
tenders.notes: IRCON-Jakson JV was the lowest bidder at Rs 1,526 crore, 26% over the estimate; L&T bid Rs 1,646 crore. No award was found. MMRDA tendered Package 2 again in 2025 as CA-298, with 5 years of maintenance; no source says CA-236 was cancelled.

tenders.scope: Power supply and traction for 24.72 km from Bhakti Park to Cadbury Junction; lifts, escalators and E&M for 22 stations and 2 depots; SCADA for Lines 4 and 4A; five years of maintenance (Package 2)
tenders.notes: Tender 2025_MMRDA_1218677_1, ref MMRDA/4/Package2/CA 298; 2,556 days. Technical bids opened 24 Oct 2025, three bidders, one rejected. Value is L&T's bid; IRCON bid Rs 1,410 crore. Date is L&T's announcement; Metro Rail News puts the financial evaluation on 21 Jan 2026. L&T gave the E&M part to Univastu India (Rs 391.76 crore, Metro Rail Today). Construction World calls the same tender CA 295.

tenders.scope: Automatic fare collection, with the central clearing house software, and maintenance after 2 years of defect liability
tenders.notes: Financed by KfW (notice KfW511103, bids due 12 Aug 2024). Technical bids opened 2 Dec 2024, three bidders; MSI Global bid Rs 256.1 crore. Aurionpro announced the win in August 2025; Metro Rail News gives the letter of acceptance after the financial evaluation of 19 Sep 2025. Contract 3,468 days; reports differ on the maintenance term (5 or 15 years).

tenders.scope: Architectural finishing and steel roofs, 7 stations: Mulund Fire Station, Mulund Naka, Teen Haath Naka, RTO Thane, Mahapalika Marg, Cadbury Junction, Majiwada
tenders.notes: Eagle Infra India was the lowest bidder (8 Feb 2024) at Rs 245.64 crore, 24% over the estimate; Landmark bid Rs 250.74 crore, Godrej & Boyce Rs 259.24 crore. No award was found.

tenders.scope: Architectural finishing and steel roofs, 7 stations: Garodia Nagar, Pant Nagar, Laxmi Nagar, Shreyas Cinema, Godrej Company, Vikhroli Metro, Surya Nagar
tenders.notes: Godrej & Boyce was the lowest bidder (February 2024) at Rs 251.02 crore, 25% over the estimate; Eagle Infra bid Rs 257.62 crore, Landmark Rs 261.80 crore. No award was found.

tenders.scope: Architectural finishing and steel roofs, 4 stations, Kapurbawdi to Dongripada
tenders.notes: "Bidding underway" on The Metro Rail Guy's Green Line page (updated 14 Sep 2025). No report of its bids was found.

tenders.scope: Architectural finishing and steel roofs, 4 stations, Vijay Garden to Gaimukh
tenders.notes: "Bidding underway" on The Metro Rail Guy's Green Line page (updated 14 Sep 2025). No report of its bids was found.

tenders.scope: Architectural finishing, 6 stations: Gandhi Nagar, Naval Housing, Bhandup Mahapalika, Bhandup Metro, Shangrila, Sonapur
tenders.notes: Tender 2025_MMRDA_1220864_1, ref MMRDA/4/MMRP/CA-290; bids closed 13 Oct 2025. No result was found.

tenders.scope: Multi-modal integration facilities at 16 stations of Lines 4 and 4A
tenders.notes: Three bidders, two rejected at the technical stage; 540 days. The award value was not published. KfW's loan includes EUR 90 million for multimodal integration (MMRDA, 2021).

tenders.scope: Road transport of metro cars and their machinery to the line, for trial runs
tenders.notes: EMD Rs 16.56 lakh; bids due 30 Jul 2025; 24 months, extendable by 12. No package number or result was found.
